accepted.summary: Only protected handlers may be in the area during application.
accepted.quote: Only protected handlers may be in the area during application.

accepted.summary: Do not enter or allow worker entry into treated areas during the Restricted-Entry Interval (REI) of 48 hours.
accepted.quote: Do not enter or allow worker entry into treated areas during the Restricted -Entry Interval (REI) of 48 hours.

accepted.summary: The REI is 72 hours in areas where average rainfall is less than 25 inches per year.
accepted.quote: The REI is 72 hours in areas where average rainfall is less than 25 inches per year.

accepted.summary: Release height cannot exceed 10 ft above vegetative canopy unless greater height is necessary for pilot safety.
accepted.quote: Do not release spray at a height greater than 10 feet above the vegetative canopy, unless a greater application height is necessary for pilot safety.

accepted.summary: Use a fine to medium or coarser droplet size (ASABE S572.I)
accepted.quote: For all applications, applicators are required to use a fine to medium or coarser droplet size (ASABE S572.I).

accepted.summary: Boom length must not exceed 65% of wingspan for airplanes.
accepted.quote: The boom length must not exceed 65% of the wingspan for airplanes or 75% of the rotor blade diameter for helicopters.

accepted.summary: Boom length must not exceed 75% of rotor blade diameter for helicopters.
accepted.quote: The boom length must not exceed 65% of the wingspan for airplanes or 75% of the rotor blade diameter for helicopters.

accepted.summary: Use ½ swath displacement upwind at the downwind edge of the field.
accepted.quote: Applicators must use ½ swath displacement upwind at the downwind edge of the field.

accepted.summary: Apply with the nozzle height recommended by the manufacturer, but no more than 3 feet above the ground or crop canopy.
accepted.quote: Apply with the nozzle height recommended by the manufacturer, but no more than 3 feet above the ground or crop canopy.

accepted.summary: Wind speed must not exceed 10 mph at the application site.
accepted.quote: Do not apply when wind speeds exceed 10 miles per hour at the application site.

accepted.summary: Do not apply during temperature inversions.
accepted.quote: Do not apply during temperature inversions.

accepted.summary: Prohibits applying the product through any type of irrigation system.
accepted.quote: Do not apply this product through any type of irrigation system.

accepted.unit: lb ethephon AI per acre per year
accepted.summary: Limits total seasonal application to 2.0 lb ethephon AI per acre per year.
accepted.quote: Do not apply more than 2.0 lb ethephon AI per acre per year.

accepted.summary: Prohibits application if rain is expected within 6 hours due to potential reduction in product performance.
accepted.quote: Do not apply this product if rain is expected within 6 hours as product performance may be reduced.

accepted.summary: Requires waiting 30 days after application before planting rotation crops unless specific conditions for small grains are met.
accepted.quote: Rotation Crop Restrictions: Do not plant back another crop within 30 days after application.

accepted.summary: Recommends using a nurse tank to help prevent spills during handling of concentrated product.
accepted.quote: (a nurse tank is recommended to help prevent spills)

accepted.summary: Specifies filling the spray tank 1/2 to 3/4 full of water before adding product and continuing agitation.
accepted.quote: Fill the spray tank 1/2 to 3/4 full of water. Agitate the water and continue agitation throughout mixing and spraying operations.

accepted.summary: Requires not allowing the spray solution to sit without agitation longer than 5 to 10 minutes.
accepted.quote: Do not allow the spray solution to sit without agitation longer than 5 to 10 minutes.

accepted.summary: Sets minimum spray volume for ground application at 10 gallons per acre.
accepted.quote: By ground: Apply in a minimum spray volume of 10 gal/A.

accepted.summary: Sets minimum spray volume for air application at 2 gallons per acre generally.
accepted.quote: By air: Apply in a minimum spray volume of 2 gal/A

accepted.summary: Sets minimum spray volume for air application at 5 gallons per acre specifically in Arizona and California.
accepted.quote: (5 gal/A in AZ and CA)

accepted.summary: product may be applied as a tank mixture or in sequence with specified products
accepted.quote: [Ethephon E-AG 6 Plant Growth Regulator] may be applied as a tank mixture or in sequence with the following products: Def ®, Folex®, Dropp®, Dropp® Ultra, Ginstar®, Harvade®, Methyl Parathion, Guthion®, and Malathion®.

accepted.summary: use caution when tank mixed with defoliants due to possible slight reduction in boll opening
accepted.quote: Use caution when this product is applied as a tank mix with defoliants as a slight reduction in boll opening could occur.

accepted.summary: only apply as tank mix with desiccants if plant desiccation is required
accepted.quote: Only apply this product as a tank mix with desiccants if plant desiccation is required.

accepted.summary: do not use a defoliant unless sufficient mature, unopened bolls are present to produce desired yield
accepted.quote: Do not use a defoliant unless sufficient mature, unopened bolls are present to produce the desired yield.

accepted.summary: do not tank mix with desiccants if cotton is to be spindle harvested
accepted.quote: DO NOT TANK MIX THIS PRODUCT WITH DESICCANTS IF COTTON IS TO BE SPINDLE HARVESTED.

accepted.summary: under certain conditions, tank mixtures with desiccants containing sodium chlorate could result in formation of hypochlorous acids which on heating will emit toxic chloride fumes
accepted.quote: UNDER CERTAIN CONDITIONS, TANK MIXT URES OF [Ethephon E-AG 6 Plant Growth Regulator] WITH DESICCANTS CONTAINING SODIUM CHLORATE COULD RESULT IN THE FORMATION OF HYPOCHLOROUS ACIDS WHICH ON HEATING WILL EMIT TOXIC CHLORIDE FUMES.

accepted.summary: do not mix this product with ammonium thiosulfate as these mixtures may result in formation of toxic fumes
accepted.quote: DO NOT MIX THIS PRODUCT WITH AMMONIUM THIOSULFATE AS THESE MIXTURES MAY RESULT IN FORMATION OF TOXIC FUMES.
